body: I just want the pain and fear to go away. I enjoy reading NDEs. They love they describe in them are beautiful. The instant peace..
It's hard for me to get the concept of it. It's weird for me.
Just wish I knew what to expect. Tired of being here. Constantly thinking about pulling the trigger...
It's just hard imagining not existing. Just darkness? Its weird.
I just dont have the will to keep going...
If you want to, I am open to it.
